about.intro_location_text: Located in the Hamburg metropolitan area, with our warehouse in Reinbek, we are ideally positioned at the heart of one of Europe's leading international logistics hubs to supply our client across Europe and worldwide.
about.warehouse_heading:
A logistics hub
in the Hamburg
metropolitan area
about.intro_text_1: We at OSTA Trading GmbH combine our decades of professional experience in pharmaceutical industry and established network of international manufacturers, to create every opportunity for our clients to succeed.
about.intro_text_2: At OSTA Trading GmbH we evolve along with you to meet your requirements.
about.intro_lead: OSTA Trading GmbH is a specialised distributor of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients and specialty ingredients for the pharmaceutical, food and cosmetics industries.
about.services_text_1: We at Osta Trading pride ourselves on offering support to our clients throughout the entire supply process. From manufacturer and product sourcing, to providing logistics solution, warehousing and regulatory support. Thanks to our immense experience inside the pharmaceutical market, we were able to establish a network of not only European, but also global manufacturers. This results in our ability to offer our clients flexible solutions that are tailored to each client's individual technical, regulatory or/and commercial requirements. We don't just supply, we deliver our best.
about.services_text_2: Our business aims to provide every one of our clients with professional pharmaceutical distribution, international sourcing and reliable logistics. Whether our clients require a product for an established commercial project or are searching for a new product for a new developing project, our highly experienced team will assist you with any request, guaranteeing to offer high-quality products at competitive prices.
about.service_manufacturer_text: Suitable APIs and excipients manufacturers. Sources matched to the technical, quality, regulatory and commercial requirements of your project.
about.service_regulatory_text: Coordination of regulatory documentation. Coordinating the regulatory documentation your project requires.
about.service_samples_text: Collection of samples Samples for your evaluation and qualification procedures.
about.service_specs_text: Specifications and quality requirements. Agreeing on the specifications and quality your project demands.
about.people_markus_quote:
“Every order starts with a conversation.
We listen first, then build the supply around your needs.”
about.people_thomas_quote:
“A reliable ingredient is only useful when it arrives on time.
That is what we work on every day.”
about.quality_title: Quality and compliance are fundamental to our operations
about.quality_text: This way we ensure appropriate handling, storage and distribution of pharmaceutical ingredients.
about.closing_title: Professionalism, reliability and long-term cooperation are at the centre of everything we do
about.closing_sub: We would love to hear your challenge.
about.closing_desc: Our knowledgeable and resourceful team will always assist you to find the answer you look for.
about.quality_specs_text: OSTA Trading GmbH is registered in EudraGMDP as an API distributor.
about.quality_gdp_text: Our Hamburg warehouse operates in compliance with GDP requirements.

about.logistics_text: OSTA Trading GmbH coordinates the supply chain from the manufacturer to the customer's destination, taking into consideration the specific handling, documentation and transport requirements applicable to pharmaceutical ingredients.

services.hero_sub:
We source APIs and excipients, coordinate documents
and samples, and deliver from our warehouse near Hamburg.
services.hero_image_alt: Truck loading at the gate of a warehouse
services.process_text: Tell us what your project needs, and we take it from there. One contact coordinates the manufacturer side, from evaluation to commercial supply.
services.process_map_label: Four stages from request to regular supply
services.supply_title:
We organise supply
from the manufacturer
to your door
services.how_text: From the first inquiry to continuous deliveries, you get support at every stage, including a forecast of future requirements prepared together with you and the manufacturer.
services.how_step_1_text: Application, specification, target market, regulatory requirements, expected volumes.
services.how_step_2_text: Dedicated search if the product is not in our portfolio; samples and documentation for your evaluation.
services.how_step_3_text: Communication with the manufacturer, technical questions, laboratory testing and qualification procedures.
services.how_step_4_title: We prepare and run the supply
services.how_step_4_text: Forecast of future requirements, a reliable supply structure, then regular procurement and distribution through our partners.
services.closing_title:
We would love
to hear your challenge
services.closing_desc: Our knowledgeable and resourceful team will help you find the answer you are looking for.
services.manufacturer_card: You get sources matched to the technical, quality, regulatory and commercial requirements of your project.
services.regulatory_card: You get one point of contact towards the manufacturer for the regulatory documentation.
services.samples_card: You get samples for your evaluation and support up to qualification.
services.specs_card: You get specifications and quality requirements agreed with the manufacturer before supply starts.
services.supply_text_1: You get deliveries organised to your requirements, from the manufacturer to your destination. We take into account the handling, documentation and transport requirements of pharmaceutical ingredients. Our warehouse in Reinbek lets us consolidate supplies and keep stock for selected products; where appropriate, we set up safety stocks and supply arrangements based on agreed forecasts and expected consumption.
services.supply_text_2: Together with logistics partners experienced in pharmaceutical and other chemical products, we coordinate international transport, import and export procedures and the shipping documents.
